description.value: The pawn forcefully expels one item from its Spring-Loaded Compartment. If the item is an alchemical bomb or a weapon with the thrown trait, the pawn can make a ranged Strike with it using its unarmed attack modifier (no invested-weapon or handwraps benefits, and returning thrown weapons fall at the pawn's feet instead). Any other item can be flung to a space up to 20 feet away.
